messages:
mara: Proposal: run an "invoice-transparent" pilot for v1->v2 rollforwards: keep runtime routed to v2 but surface origin breakdown in invoices & Console for 30 days. want quick takes.
jonathan: Love it. main ask from billing: no surprise line-item deltas. invoices must show both 'billed_as' and 'origin_as' token columns.
katie: From infra POV we need a lightweight signal. Suggest emitting origin_tag="v1" and routed_tag="v2" on the usage ping. its easy to add.
priya: We should sample at 100% for the pilot but only persist origin_tag for 30 days. privacy/legal okay with transient storage?
katie: confirm retention TTL=30d, redact headers past TTL. mark as non-PII.
ella-ux: UX ask: invoice rows should have a chevron to expand to a small panel: show origin breakdown and link to Route Preview. also in Route page show a toggle 'Show invoice origin breakdown'.
mara: Nice. Operational concern: we'll need a migration metric so product can see how many requests are silently routed. propose metric `routing.origin_visible_count` with tags route/tenant.
jonathan: Also emit `routing.estimated_bill_delta` for previews. billing can use it to precompute the expand view.
katie: Implementation plan: router sets header X-RW-Origin: v1 when auto-routed. usage pipeline attaches it to ingest events. i'll keep it opt-in for tenants via console flag.
priya: Opt-in is important. we should default pilot to internal-only tenants first. Also add an enterprise toggle for customers who want dual-reporting.
mara: Rollout steps: internal tenants dry-run -> billing preview enabled -> sample 10 production tenants opt-in -> full 30-day pilot opt-in. rollback if more than 3 support tickets per day or invoice dispute rate >0.2%.
ella-ux: Copy for invoice line: "Billed as v2 (origin v1)" with tooltip: "Calls transparently routed; click to see origin breakdown." Keep language non-technical.
jonathan: Edgecases: cached requests that rewrite headers earlier in proxy chain may lose origin. router must set header as late as possible. unit test this.
katie: Good catch. We'll set header in the final hop before usage ping. Add integration test across proxies.
priya: Data retention: store origin_tag only in billing DB for 30 days; usage analytics can sample to longer retention but without tenant IDs.
mara: Action items: katie infra header + metric (owner: katie), jonathan add routing metrics and unit tests (owner: jonathan), priya coordinate retention policy with legal (owner: priya), ella-ux mock invoice expand (owner: ella-ux). target dry-run for internal tenants by EOD Thu.
devops-bot: (system) scheduled job queued: invoice-transparent-pilot-1768604321 -> will post status updates to thread.
mara: Thanks all. call out if any tenant-facing compliance issues; otherwise i'll open the pilot PR.
